items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, was in the band. We worked in the - and I remember the place where we worked.

ctx.x: Yeah, was in the band. We worked in the - and I remember the place where we worked. We worked a place called the Club Cadix, I think Chestnut Street. Anyway it's a high-class club, but it turned out to be low-class because somebody got killed in front of the door there, and it closed after 2 weeks. Now that was a big band. So I mean that was a big band, so I, that's why I - so I made a mistake when I said the first big band was Charlie Miller - Charlie Johnson. It wasn't, it was this band, that the first big…
